title: CPE RFP 26-16743 released — prepare for new MPA
body: Cal OES released RFP 26-16743 for statewide 9-1-1 Call Processing Equipment (cloud or on-premise). Estimated award/start mid-August 2026 (solicitation estimates). PSAPs should continue Chapter III funding processes, use Advance Notification, and plan Cloud vs On-Prem evaluation. After award, new purchases use authorized contractors under the new MPA — not historical 2020 price sheets.

title: How Advisors’ role is changing (share with your PSAP)
body: Under the new contract, Advisors focus less on ad-hoc vendor vetting and more on: directing PSAPs to the awarded pool, processing standardized Advance Notifications (Cloud vs On-Prem), SOW completeness (Attachment 16), TD-288 packages, and invoice compliance (Attachments 14/15). Use the portal wizards and checkers before emailing your Advisor.
